juhi: Quick sanity check — new vector model v7-small-tiles deployed to staging. Ran recall@10 on wiki-holdout and numbers look lower than expected.
alex: baseline numbers?
juhi: baseline (v5-prod) recall@10 = 0.87, v7 run = 0.81 on same dataset and seed.
nadeem: did you use the same index/build params (hnsw_m / ef_construction / metric)?
juhi: yes — hnsw_m=64, ef_construction=200, ef_search=200. Tried cosine and dot, drop persists.
marta: were either model or preprocessing changed? tokenization, pooling, normalization?
juhi: preprocessing identical. main model diffs: small contrastive head + final L2 postnorm. No quantization, both fp16.
alex: can you paste the eval snippet you used?
juhi: ```python
# quick recall@k snippet
def recall_at_k(q_embs, db_embs, gt_idx, k=10):
    D, I = faiss_index.search(q_embs, k)
    return np.mean([1 if gt in I[i] else 0 for i, gt in enumerate(gt_idx)])
```
ops-bot: model-deploy: v7-small-tiles promoted to staging at 2034567890 (build 2026-03-20T08:05Z)
marta: i'll run per-class recall and embedding-drift (mean cosine shift) slices. Also check short vs long queries.
juhi: kicking off ci-eval on ci-eval-4 (wiki-holdout split) — ETA ~18m. will post results here.
alex: :thumbsup:
juhi: ci-eval done: per-slice summary — short queries (<6 tokens) recall@10 dropped 0.69 -> 0.60; medium (6-20) 0.85 -> 0.83; long stable. Looks concentrated on short queries.
marta: interesting — could be contrastive head overfitting to longer context. let's run a tiny ablation removing postnorm and see.
juhi: launching ablation (v7-no-postnorm). will report back.
